validated_correction.rationale: Place failures (not_released_and_settled_at_goal) are the most frequent error (26/60 trials) and often occur at high commanded speed factors (>4). The timing oracle alone improves success by ~11.7 pp, indicating that reducing execution speed mitigates placement errors. Capping the speed factor at 3.0 aligns with the range of successful trials and should reduce overshoot/settling issues without overly slowing the robot.
